# FlexiTap POS

> An offline-first point-of-sale (POS) and merchant operating system engineered for retail stores, restaurants, cafes, food trucks, and professional service businesses. Operates with 100% functionality on local SQLite database engines even when internet connectivity drops.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Offline-First Resilience**: Ring up orders, calculate change, apply tax/discounts, split bills, and print kitchen order tickets (KOT) without internet.
- **Zero Cloud Latency**: Counter tenders execute in under 15ms directly on local device hardware.
- **BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)**: Runs on existing iPad, Android tablet, Windows PC, or Mac hardware. Zero proprietary terminal lease lock-ins.
- **Local Network Sync (mDNS)**: Terminal-to-terminal and terminal-to-KDS communication occurs over local Wi-Fi/LAN without relying on external cloud servers.
- **Automatic Cloud Sync**: Transaction records, inventory deltas, and telemetry automatically synchronize with the cloud once internet access is restored.

## Industry Verticals & Solutions
- [Cafes & Bakeries](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-cafes.html): Barista rush speed, KOT printing, milk/syrup modifier groups, offline cash drawer kick.
- [Retail & Boutiques](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-retail.html): 100,000+ SKU capacity, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner integration, color/size variant matrices, stockroom inventory auditing.
- [Quick-Serve & Food Trucks](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-quick-service.html): 3-second counter checkouts, real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) bump bar routing, order status pickup displays.
- [Fine Dining & Full Service](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-fine-dining.html): Visual table layout and floor plans, timed course firing (apps, mains, desserts), seat-level bill splitting, sommelier wine cellar tracking.
- [Professional Services & Salons](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-professional-services.html): Appointment scheduling, client checkout with custom tip screens, multi-stylist commission splits, zero per-booking platform fees.

## Key Hardware Compatibility
- **Receipt & Kitchen Printers**: ESC/POS compliant thermal printers (Ethernet LAN, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, serial).
- **Barcode Scanners**: 1D and 2D QR barcode scanner guns operating via USB HID keyboard emulation or Bluetooth SPP/HID.
- **Cash Drawers**: Standard RJ11/RJ12 24V printer-driven kick ports.
- **Operating Systems**: Web (PWA), Windows 10/11, macOS, Android (v8.0+), iOS / iPadOS (v14+).

## Pricing & Licensing
- **Free Community Plan**: $0/month forever. 1 active terminal, full local SQLite offline capability, receipt printing, and basic reporting.
- **Founders VIP Annual Pass**: $590/year (or custom retail tier upon public launch Nov 13, 2026). Unlimited paired terminals, multi-station KDS routing, customer display (CDS), remote diagnostics, and multi-location cloud synchronization.
- **Zero Hidden Terminal Fees**: No recurring per-terminal software leases or forced merchant processing contracts.

## Technical Architecture & Benchmarks
- **Local Engine**: Embedded SQLite database with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL).
- **Execution Speed**: Sub-15ms local barcode and SKU queries.
- **Peer Sync**: UDP/TCP LAN socket protocol with mDNS auto-discovery.
- **Cloud Backend**: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS) and real-time delta replication.
